en.headline: Medical products regulator head pledges independent path, not mini-FDA
en.dek: Li Zili says the new centre will use Hong Kong’s strategic position and mainland drug pipelines to earn global trust while focusing on areas such as rare diseases.
body: The controller of Hong Kong’s forthcoming Centre for Medical Products Regulation, Li Zili, has said the body will build comprehensive capabilities and seek international trust rather than copy existing models.

Speaking to reporters, Li said the centre, which is to be established by the end of the year, aims to promote primary evaluation of drugs and medical devices so that patients can access them faster. “We are not going to be a mini-FDA, nor a miniature version of any regulatory body in the world,” he told the South China Morning Post.

He pointed to the “one country, two systems” principle and the mainland’s pharmaceutical industry, which accounts for about a third of the global active innovative drug pipeline, as advantages that could help the centre serve both local patients and those elsewhere. The centre will also set up an interdisciplinary scientific team focused on clinical review.

Li, a former US Food and Drug Administration official with more than 30 years of experience, was appointed in October after a global recruitment exercise. The government has said the centre will accelerate clinical use of products that meet quality and safety standards.

zh.headline: 藥械監管總監李自力強調獨立路線 非縮小版FDA
zh.dek: 李自力表示，新中心將善用香港策略位置及內地藥品研發管線，建立國際信任，並聚焦罕見病等領域。
body: 即將成立的香港藥物及醫療器械監管中心總監李自力表示，中心將建立全面能力，爭取國際信任，而非複製現有模式。
李自力向記者指出，中心預計年底前成立，目標是推動藥物及醫療器械的第一層審評，加快臨床應用。他對《南華早報》說：「我們不會成為迷你版FDA，也不會成為世界上任何監管機構的縮小版。」
他提到「一國兩制」原則及內地藥品業的優勢，後者約佔全球活躍創新藥研發管線三分之一，有助中心服務本地及海外病人。中心亦會設立跨專業科學審評團隊，專注臨床審查。
李自力曾任美國食品藥物管理局官員，擁有逾30年經驗，經全球招聘後於10月獲委任。政府表示，中心將加快符合質素及安全標準的產品臨床應用。
